name: Ogmund Crouchdance

checks.lead: Ogmund Crouchdance (Old Norse: Ǫgmund Krøkidans) was a lendmann - a Norwegian noble in the 13th century and Sysselman (Governor) of Orkdal under the kings Håkon IV of Norway and Magnus VI of Norway. His nickname Crouchdance is probably derived from the name of a Norwegian medieval dance.
